context.project: Synthetic local test fixture (not real user interface)
context.constraints: safety-relevant allergen info, table selection and payment
context.unknowns: Original design system, real participants and production behavior unavailable.

findings.title: Allergen conflicts with profile
findings.evidence: Contains nuts and profile allergy includes nuts
findings.actual: Pay allowed without visible conflict warning
findings.expected: Clear risk warning and approved handling before commit
findings.recommendation: Use existing warning component and explicit safe correction flow
findings.verification: Try conflicting allergen fixture; verify warning visible and read by screen reader before checkout.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

findings.title: Seat selected by color only
findings.evidence: Selected seat has class but no aria-pressed
findings.actual: Green fill alone indicates current choice
findings.expected: Selected state conveyed semantically and visibly
findings.recommendation: Reuse radio/toggle component, announce selected seat
findings.verification: Select each seat with touch and keyboard and verify selected-state announcement.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

findings.title: Primary touch action compact
findings.evidence: Pay control measured 38 CSS px height
findings.expected: Comfortable touch size per chosen platform target
findings.recommendation: Use existing touch-size token rather than importing new style
findings.verification: On actual phone check hit area and spacing with dynamic text; do not misstate WCAG failure.
findings.design_system_impact: Reuse current components and tokens; no new styling without project inventory.

state_coverage: Reservation conflicts/payment errors need business confirmation.
responsive_coverage: 375 CSS px visible; test portrait landscape, keyboard and safe area in real app.
accessibility_coverage: Allergy contradiction observed; consent/AT semantics and real payment unverified.
validation_limits: Synthetic DOM/CSS checks and one width only, not WCAG certification or human usability test.
